item.text: The required construction is the residual \(\Delta A=\widehat R^T\widehat R-A\). The main work is deriving its entrywise bound from the actual rounded recurrence, especially the square-root step. The paper leaves that step implicit, and its first-row cases need separate handling to justify the stated \(\gamma_{n+1}\) constant.
